description: This file defines the CandidateRejectionAPI class, an API endpoint for rejecting candidates within the recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It includes a method to specify the resulting workflow state after rejection and documentation annotations for API specifications.

classes.name: CandidateRejectionAPI
classes.description: API class providing candidate rejection functionality within the recruitment workflow, inherits from AbstractCandidateActionAPI.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the workflow state indicating a candidate has been rejected.
